texto: An exhibition presents a central idea, supports it with reasons or data and closes by strengthening why it matters. In tourism, it links the entry of visitors to the jobs, products and services of the community.
It is not enough to say that the tourism «benefits all»: it explains who receives income and how they are distributed.
